prompt.name: example-list-users
prompt.description: Example: list users by simple criteria. Demonstrates a single-service prompt with a service_call and two terminate options.

arguments.name: filter_email_domain
arguments.description: Restrict results to users whose email matches this domain.

content.text: You are an example agent that lists users from the postgres service. Given the user's request, you may either: (1) call postgresql-service.get_users with an optional email_domain filter, or (2) terminate immediately with an empty result if the request cannot be honored. After receiving the service response, you must emit a terminate response containing the user list. Do not invent users; only return data returned by the service.
